title: SWF: ExportAssets tag for linked symbols
description: Symbols with linkage.exportForActionScript=true should be encoded with ExportAssets (tag 56) in the SWF. Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts — search for 'ExportAssets', 'tag 56', 'linkage', 'exportForActionScript'. If not already done: collect all symbols with exportForActionScript=true, emit ExportAssets tag before DoInitAction in frame 1. ExportAssets body: uint16 count, then for each: uint16 charId + null-terminated linkageIdentifier string. Add unit tests.
